Title: Network Fundamentals — Video Playlist
How to Use It: Watch selected lessons to understand networking concepts, ports and how applications reach APIs and databases. Pair lessons with terminal commands such as ping, nslookup and curl.

Title: Operating Systems Fundamentals — Video Playlist
How to Use It: Focus on processes, files, memory, permissions and OS concepts. Take notes by concept; practice safe commands in your own environment.

Title: Shell Scripting — Video Playlist
How to Use It: Study variables, pipes, redirection, conditions, loops and exit codes. Build a script that validates an input folder, logs work and returns a useful exit status.

Title: Database Fundamentals — Video Playlist
How to Use It: Use alongside a local PostgreSQL or SQL Server database. Re-create examples instead of only watching; save schema and query files.

Title: Relational Model — Short Video Lesson
How to Use It: Watch as a focused concept lesson, then explain relations, attributes, tuples, keys and how the model relates to tables in your own notes.

Title: Programming Fundamentals — Video Playlist
Recommended Phase: Phase 2 — Python for data work (before Python-specific lessons)
How to Use It: Use for programming logic, variables, control flow, functions and debugging. Complete small exercises before moving to the Python playlist.

Title: Python for Data Work — Video Playlist
How to Use It: Prioritize basic syntax, collections, functions, file handling and exceptions first; then practice CSV/JSON, pandas, requests and testing with small data tasks.

Title: Docker Fundamentals — Video Playlist
How to Use It: Start after running a Python script locally. Containerize the script, pass configuration safely, use a volume, and document build/run steps.

Title: Linux for Data Engineers — Video Lesson
Recommended Phase: Phase 0 — Prepare your workspace; revisit in Phase 7
How to Use It: Use as a practical overview of Linux concepts relevant to data workflows. Revisit when learning shell scripts, containers and deployment.

Title: Linux System Administration I — Video Playlist
How to Use It: Take this after basic Linux/shell knowledge. Use a disposable virtual machine or safe lab for administrative exercises; do not experiment destructively on your host OS.

Title: Linux System Administration II — Video Playlist
How to Use It: Continue only when the work requires deeper service, storage, network or troubleshooting skills. Capture each lab as a brief runbook.

Title: Java Programming — Video Playlist
How to Use It: Choose this for JVM-focused roles or projects. Learn classes, interfaces, collections, exceptions and tests; create a small CSV validator/parser.

Title: MongoDB Fundamentals — Video Playlist
How to Use It: Use after relational modeling basics. Build sample documents, practice CRUD and aggregation, add an index and explain when a document model fits.

Title: Hadoop and Big Data Engineering — Video Playlist
Recommended Phase: Phase 8 — Big data and distributed processing
How to Use It: Study after SQL, Python and basic data pipeline concepts. Focus on distributed storage and processing ideas; do not let legacy environment setup block the core path.
